chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 253 – Shenyong Nong Arrives in Anchan with Death Warrior Gifts
chapter_meta_description: A new power player arrives in Anchan Commandery—Shenyong Nong, one of the Four Young Masters of the Grand Xia. Beishan Yin offers a shocking gift of ten Wanxiang death warriors, and Ji Ning's name is mentioned.
og_title: A Noble's Trial and a Genius's Name
og_description: The ancient Shenyong clan heir arrives for a secret trial. Political gifts of death warriors are exchanged, and the name 'Ji Ning' enters the conversation of the elites.
twitter_description: A massive political web closes in. Shenyong Nong arrives in Anchan, and a huge gift of death warriors is delivered. The chessboard is set, and Ji Ning is on the board.

lore_anchors.definition: The heir apparent to the Shenyong clan, one of the Four Young Masters of the Grand Xia Imperial Capital. He is a young noble undergoing a clan trial to secure his position as the next Duke Yi, wielding immense political and military influence.
A powerful political figure in Anchan Commandery and the father of Beishan Hu. He is a master of scheming and patience, widely seen as a top candidate for the next Marquis of Anchan.

The Grand Xia Dynasty's elite immortal corps. Membership requires at least the Wanxiang (Myriad Manifestations) realm, and they are ranked by 'Claws' indicating their relative power, with higher levels being comparable to Primal Daoists.
The title of the chieftain of the Shenyong clan, an ancient and powerful tribe that served as a founding pillar of the Grand Xia Dynasty. The title is one of the highest noble ranks in the empire.

A fanatical, expendable soldier trained for suicide missions or absolute loyalty. It is incredibly rare and expensive to train cultivators as death warriors, making their use a sign of extreme wealth and political desperation.
A rank within the Yinglong Guard, signifying a member whose combat prowess is comparable to a Primal Daoist. They are elite operatives, a step above the standard Wanxiang-level recruits.
A high-ranking immortal overseeing the Yinglong Guard outpost in the Crimson Dragon Mountains. He acts as a local power broker and is tasked with allocating elite resources for the imperial corps.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a 'Test from the Clan'?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A 'trial' or 'test' from a major clan, especially for the heir, is a high-stakes mission used to prove their capability and leadership potential. Failure can cost them their inheritance, and success requires them to marshal external resources and allies.

Cultivators need a strong, independent will to advance. Training someone as a 'death warrior' (a fanatical slave) directly conflicts with this, making it incredibly difficult to cultivate them to high levels. A gift of ten such Wanxiang Adepts is a staggering asset.

He is the heir to the Shenyong clan, one of the most ancient and powerful noble families in the Grand Xia, almost on par with the imperial clan. He is known as one of the 'Four Young Masters' of the Imperial Capital, a title denoting his extreme status and influence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the East Stone Immortal and Beishan Yin give him gifts?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are 'political investments'. They hope that by helping Shenyong Nong succeed in his trial now, he will remember their loyalty and favor them with power and patronage when he becomes the all-powerful Duke Yi in the future.
